A1.justification: Both PDFs are 21-page versions of the same CoA-LoRA paper. Text and rendered-page comparisons cover the main text, references, and Appendices A–C without material reading gaps.

before.justification: v3 reports original CoA-LoRA experiments in Section 5 and Appendix C, including GLUE accuracy, C4 perplexity, training time, zero-shot performance, and ablations.

after.justification: v4 retains the original experimental results in Section 5 and Appendix C, including benchmark comparisons, zero-shot evaluations, and sensitivity analyses.

M1.justification: The configuration-aware mapper, SVD initialization, LoRA adjustment, and Pareto-based configuration search and filtering are identical in Section 4 and Appendix A.

E1.justification: Both versions use C4, QNLI, MNLI, SST-2, QQP, and the same downstream tasks in Table C.3. Unseen-configuration and integer-quantization scenarios are also unchanged.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged within corresponding experiments, including QLoRA, LQ-LoRA, Shared-LoRA, GPTQ-LoRA where evaluated, and the full-fine-tuning reference curves.

E3.justification: The reported backbones, ranks, bit-width settings, training budgets, sequence lengths, metrics, and calibration procedures are identical in Section 5.1 and Appendices A–C.

E4.justification: The unseen-configuration tests, configuration-search controls, rank and integer-quantization analyses, matrix correlations, and segment-count sensitivity studies are retained unchanged.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is identical. Neither version reports experimental seed or repeated-run counts, confidence intervals, or significance tests.

E6.justification: All numerical entries and plotted results match, including Tables 2–4 and C.2–C.5. For example, Table 2 reports the same CoA-LoRA QNLI HV of 0.62, accuracy gap of +4.34%, and training time of 57 minutes.

T1.justification: The mathematical objectives, GP/EHVI formulation, finite-difference updates, Pareto definitions, and appendix formulations in Equations 1–14 are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain identical claims about adapting LoRA to arbitrary quantization configurations without repeated fine-tuning and achieving competitive or superior performance.

C2.justification: Interpretations of configuration-search gains, unseen-configuration generalization, adapter correlations, and SST-2's task-dependent behavior are unchanged. No applicability boundary or limitation is revised.

D1.justification: Mapper architecture, initialization, hyperparameters, parameter counts, calibration details, solver information, and reported timing remain identical. The implementation link in Section 5.1 is unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2 and the reference list are identical, preserving the same positioning relative to LoRA, quantization, and adapter-generation research.

P1.justification: v4 corrects 'conferencce' to 'conference' in every running header and updates the arXiv stamp from v3, 10 Apr 2026, to v4, 22 Jun 2026. The narrative, terminology, and section structure are otherwise identical.

P2.justification: All figures, tables, captions, and their placements are identical, including the appendices. Rendered page bodies match exactly; the header and version-stamp text edits do not alter the body layout.

improvement.justification: The only differences are the running-header spelling correction and updated arXiv version/date stamp. Scientific content, experimental evidence, reproducibility information, and substantive presentation are identical throughout both PDFs, so the cosmetic correction does not meaningfully change overall paper quality.
